summary: Retest of the iteration-45 bodychart fixes. Backend: test_bodychart_v3.py was rewritten so its tests are independent, and new tests cover the fixes; all 18 pass. test_bodychart_v2.py was updated for the approved changes, and v2 plus v1 pass 13/13. Frontend at mobile 390 (Playwright, real seed visit 6ae113e80a4226bae532c310) also passes: a short tap or a short drag does not move a pin; a long-press drag of a pin with photos into the genital zone opens the intimate dialog; Cancel keeps the pin in place and Confirm moves it, after which the DB shows both photos reserved and a 'bodychart_foto_riservata_marcata' audit entry. The other checks passed too: tap figure -> Nevo -> photo -> save; dropping a proposal and Verifica+save both call /handled and the proposal never returns after reopening; Confronta shows dates with times and the lesion stati; the mouth detail testid and hotspot position are correct; the sheet is about 62vh.

minor.issue: If no bodychart_suggestions cache document exists yet, update_one runs without upsert, so the call silently does nothing but still returns ok:true and writes an audit entry.

When the note changes (new hash), the 'handled' list is kept because of $setOnInsert. A region handled for an old note is therefore never proposed again, even if the new note mentions it. Confirm this is intended.
The 'view' form field is a free string, not validated against VIEWS. This is harmless, because PUT forces reserved for photos on pins in the intimate zone, but it should be Literal-validated.

integration_issues.issue: POST /bodychart/suggest is called twice on every editor open (double effect). The second call is a cache hit, so it costs no LLM call, but it is a redundant request.

issues: Date option text says '1 reperti': it should be singular '1 reperto'.
The compare date pickers are native <select> elements, not shadcn Select (minor and consistent with the descrittore select).

action_items: Optional: upsert (or 404) in suggestion_handled when no cache document exists.
Optional: reset or scope 'handled' when the note hash changes, if re-proposal for an edited note is wanted.
Optional: deduplicate the double POST /suggest on editor mount.
Optional: pluralization '1 reperto' in the Confronta date options.
critical_code_review_comments: put_chart reserved forcing is correct and idempotent: the audit is written only when modified_count > 0, which a test verifies. Moving a pin back out of the zone does not un-reserve the photo (conservative and fine).
Log dedupe scans every audit entry for the same action and owner within the 10-minute window and decrypts each subject. This is fine at the current scale; an indexed subject hash would scale better.
Frontend move() asks for confirmation only when the pin goes from outside the zone to inside it and has photos. Correct.
